model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the convergence behavior of different model training configurations over iterations, plotting Loss (y-axis) against #Iteration (x-axis). The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to approximately 150,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is also linear, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Six distinct lines are shown: “Vanilla” (purple, solid line) starts near Loss=3.35 at 0 iterations and decreases steadily to about 2.55 by 150,000 iterations. “StrmLLM (n=64)” (cyan, solid) begins around 3.3 and declines to ~2.5. “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange, solid) starts near 3.25 and ends around 2.5. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green, solid) begins at ~3.2 and ends near 2.5. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red, solid) starts at ~3.2 and ends slightly above 2.5. “SepLLM (n=128)” (blue, solid) begins at ~3.3 and ends around 2.55. All lines exhibit a rapid initial drop in loss followed by a slower convergence, with minor variations in final loss values and convergence rates.
